findings.title: No server-side signature verification
findings.description: record_payment_transaction accepts the Razorpay signature parameter but unconditionally sets verified=true without computing the HMAC-SHA256 hash and comparing it. An attacker can submit razorpay_payment_id='pay_anything' with a random signature and it will be recorded as a verified captured payment. Block deployment until signature verification is implemented using RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET from Supabase vault.

findings.title: Fake order_id will cause checkout failure
findings.description: create_razorpay_order generates a local order_id (order_<random_hex>) instead of calling Razorpay's Orders API. When RazorpayPaymentButton passes this to Razorpay's checkout SDK, Razorpay will reject the unknown order_id and the checkout will fail. Production deployment requires calling Razorpay's POST /v1/orders endpoint with Basic Auth (key_id:key_secret) and returning the real order_id from the response.

findings.title: Payment transactions missing from XLSX export
findings.description: export-utils.ts was updated to recognize native payment answers (by checking if the value starts with pay_), but the export pipeline doesn't fetch the payment_transactions table or add columns for amount, status, currency, and verified flag. The implementation plan (Step 9) calls for adding 4 columns per payment question but the code only shows the payment_id in the answer column. Admins exporting responses won't see payment verification status or amounts.
